ja306:1.1: Kiṃ aṇḍakā ime deva nikkhittā kaṃsamallake upalohitakā vaggū, te me akkhāhi pucchito ti.
ja306:2.1: Yāni pure tuvaṃ devi bhaṇḍu nantakavāsinī ucchaṅgahatthā pacināsi tassā te koliyaṃ phalaṃ.
ja306:3.1: Uḍayhate na ramati, bhogā vippajahanti taṃ, tatth' ev' imaṃ paṭinetha yattha kolaṃ pacissatīti.
ja306:4.1: Honti h' ete mahārāja iddhippattāya nāriyā, khama deva Sujātāya, māssā kujjhi rathesabhā 'ti.
